result.title: CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI
result.summary: Pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy is a key prognostic indicator in aggressive breast cancer, yet existing prediction approaches either rely on pretreatment imaging alone, missing the patient's evolving response, or optimize multi-visit classifiers under direct outcome supervision, coupling representation learning with the clinical endpoint. We formulate longitudinal pCR prediction as a world-modeling problem and propose Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM), which learns a latent state-transition model that predicts the next imaging state from the observed sequence. The transition function is conditioned on patient clinical profile and assigned therapy through additive shift and feature-wise modulation, enabling patient- and treatment-specific dynamics. A Factorized Response State pathway further decouples treatment-response dynamics from imaging appearance by encoding the structural prior that response manifests primarily in lesion morphology. After pretraining, all parameters are frozen and a linear readout predicts pCR at each clinical decision point. We evaluate CoRe-WM on I-SPY2 under five-fold cross-validation and assess cross-cohort transfer on I-SPY1. CoRe-WM achieves the highest discrimination among all evaluated methods at every prospective decision point, and demonstrates robust cross-cohort transfer. Ablation studies identify patient-profile conditioning and the factorized response pathway as the principal contributors. These results establish world-model-based representation learning as a promising framework for outcome prediction in oncology and beyond.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把纵向 pCR 预测重构为世界建模问题，提出 CoRe-WM：用患者临床信息与治疗方案通过加性偏移和特征级调制来条件化隐状态转移，并设置因子化的「响应状态」通路分离治疗响应动态与成像外观，预训练后冻结全部参数、仅用线性读出做逐决策点预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其隐状态转移建模、条件化状态更新与冻结表示加线性读出评估，可能为 LVR 提供「推理状态如何随证据更新」及「latent 中保留多少任务必要信息」的可核查线索；因子化通路分离动态与视觉外观的思路，或可对照视觉细节保留与信息坍缩问题，但属医学影像领域，迁移性需人工判断。
